provenance.source: PR #12386 Parse dimensions defined on dbt columns into a semantic model, merged 2026-01-26
provenance.note: the new v2 reader builds a Dimension from a column-level definition whose name may differ from the column, and comments that the expression argument is not supported for column-based dimensions, so the dimension name becomes the identifier; the fix sets the expression to the column name when the two differ (#12512), and it is a two-defect squash (the same commit also changes how foreign-key constraints resolve ref() under deferral)

keywords: the dimension name instead of the column
bugs.note: name falls back to the dimension's own name while no expression is set, so a dimension whose name differs from its column is read as a column of that name; the fix sets the expression to the column name when the two differ
